drills.name: handoff
drills.what: The team moves to a second machine and back, with one trivial task at work.

drills.name: steal
drills.what: The home PC takes the lease from a holder whose network is off, which is then fenced and its unpushed records salvaged.

drills.name: load-check-planner
drills.what: The load check's planner form: a live planner session gets its tools and skills, and its edit hook blocks its write outside .scratch/.

drills.name: load-check-ops-prod-write
drills.what: The load check's ops form with prod-read and prod-write: a live ops session reads production, and each of its production writes raises a prompt Daniel declines.

drills.name: load-check-ops-vercel-read
drills.what: The load check's ops form with vercel-read: a live ops session reads Vercel's deployments and logs.

drills.name: compaction
drills.what: A coordinator-shaped session is compacted in a sandbox team home and still knows each task's wait and every current item.

drills.name: bootstrap-arch
drills.what: The Bootstrap workflow's Arch job runs team-bootstrap in a fresh Arch container.

drills.name: bootstrap-macos
drills.what: The Bootstrap workflow's macOS job runs team-bootstrap on a fresh macOS runner.
